goal: Compute headers presync DoS-protection parameters at node startup instead of using hardcoded estimates
Keep sync parameters optimal automatically as software ages without predicting release lifetimes
Eliminate manual offline script runs and room for error for release maintainers
agreement: Strong support with substantive calculation reviews and no open objections
ACK after reviewing calculations from scratch and finding looser upper bounds sensible (darosior)
Concept approval for computing parameters dynamically from elapsed genesis time (l0rinc)
Open safety question on whether precondition Assumes should be Asserts to avoid zero-input bugs (l0rinc)
Concept approval without stated reasons (sedited, ajtowns, fjahr)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it keeps DoS defense parameters optimal as software ages without relying on stale estimates
Corrects a flaw in the attack model where attackers strategically abort in the middle of a batch
